newsitem.title: POLAND: GDANSKI GROUP LENDS SZCZECIN YARD $45 MLN.
newsitem.headline: GDANSKI GROUP LENDS SZCZECIN YARD $45 MLN.

text.p: A consortium of eight Polish banks led by Bank Gdanski signed on February 24 an agreement with the Szczecin shipyard to lend it $44.9 million for the construction of two ships, Gdanski said in a Tuesday statement.
It said the share of Gdanski in the credit, which is to be paid back by the end of November 1997, is $14 million.

The other banks in the consortium are: Bank Zachodni SA, BIG, Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA, Bank Handlowy International in Luxemburg, WBK, Powszechny Bank Gospodarczy SA and Big Bank SA -- a subsidiary of BIG.
